quarterly_data.signal: IRA price setting per the 10-K: the HHS 'maximum fair price' for Eliquis applies to the U.S. Medicare channel effective January 1, 2026; in November 2025 the HHS announced the maximum fair price for Pomalyst, effective January 1, 2027; and in January 2026 the HHS selected Orencia for negotiation of government-set prices beginning in 2028. BMS says more of its products could be selected in future years.
quarterly_data.figure: Eliquis effective January 1, 2026; Pomalyst effective January 1, 2027; Orencia from 2028

quarterly_data.signal: As part of its diabetes termination agreement with AstraZeneca, BMS received royalty payments based on net sales, which amounted to 14% or $1.2 billion in 2025 (15% or $1.2 billion in 2024); per the 10-K, royalty payments under this agreement terminated as of December 31, 2025.
quarterly_data.figure: 14% or $1.2 billion in 2025; terminated as of December 31, 2025
